name: ptpn-tests
description: Database (RLS) and browser end-to-end checks for PTPN. Runs on an in-memory Postgres (PGlite), no Supabase project needed.

scripts.build:e2e: cd .. && VITE_SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:4180 VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=anon-key npx vite build --outDir tests/.out/e2e-dist
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm run build:e2e && npm run test:e2e
